meta.description:
A crumbling three-storey lighthouse rises from storm-battered storage vaults through cramped crew quarters to a glass-walled lantern chamber. Its
  route coils around stacked stair halls, with salt-worn masonry below and exposed ironwork giving way to pale beacon glass above.

layout.description:
A crumbling three-storey lighthouse rises from storm-battered storage vaults through cramped crew quarters to a glass-walled lantern chamber. Its
  route coils around stacked stair halls, with salt-worn masonry below and exposed ironwork giving way to pale beacon glass above.

rooms.name: Wreckage Foyer
rooms.style: The wind-lashed base entry is a low stone receiving room piled with salvaged rope, driftwood, and battered supply crates. Furnish it with rough sandstone superquadrics, dark iron hooks, and wet timber forms.

rooms.name: Salt Cellar
rooms.style: A cold, narrow store for salt barrels and preserved provisions, its masonry furred with pale mineral streaks. Use squat barrel-like superquadrics, chalky stone, and corroded metal bands.

rooms.name: Chain Winch Store
rooms.style: A taller utility store holds a massive rusted hoist, chain coils, oil cans, and spare lantern machinery. Furnish it with heavy dark-metal superquadrics and splintered dockwood supports.

rooms.name: Lower Spiral Stair
rooms.style: A square masonry stair hall encloses a tight winding stair rising away from the flooded stores. Build the stair as layered worn stone wedges around an iron central post, with damp green-grey walls.

rooms.name: Crew Landing
rooms.style: The middle stair hall opens onto a cramped landing marked by scuffed boots, brass fittings, and a rail around the continuing spiral. Use chipped painted timber, rounded iron rails, and a central stair column.

rooms.name: Watchkeepers' Bunks
rooms.style: A long, close crew sleeping room contains stacked bunks, sea chests, wool blankets, and a small potbelly stove. Make the furnishing worn navy-painted timber, dull brass, and softened rectangular superquadrics.

rooms.name: The Chart Room
rooms.style: A practical navigation room centers on a broad chart table surrounded by cabinets, rolled charts, and a rain-streaked slit window. Use warm oiled wood, parchment-like forms, brass instruments, and deep blue accents.

rooms.name: Keepers' Galley
rooms.style: A narrow upper-service room holds a coal range, kettle, bench, hanging mugs, and shelves of tins for the isolated keepers. Furnish it in soot-dark iron, scrubbed wood, and faded cream enamel.
